# R46 amendments (15 Oct 2026): results (generated by amend_report.py; statistics only)

Money in USD. v1 and v2 at the other AI's size (1,000 contracts = 1 BTC); perp per 1 BTC; the dip buy at $300 of premium a trade. Main fill: the one-minute-later fill + half spread. After tax = 31.2% of each winning trade's gross gain, no set-off. p = random-entry twins (1,000 draws, same days); q = BH over the 22-variant family (R46's 14 + v2 x 4 + dip x 4) for that view, part and cost reading. 'delta' = Delta India fees + 18% GST (R46's own, the gate); 'cs_gst' / 'cs_nogst' = CoinSwitch PRO 0.015% of notional with / without 18% GST (third-party figure, unverified). The final test is R46's holdout span, already read once by R46.
